Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 6, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the date format from the Wikipedia page. The Wikipedia page clearly states "11 September 1962". However, the Planner's analysis claimed this was "standardized to 11/09/1962 in MM/DD => November 9, 1962". This is a critical error in date parsing: in the MM/DD format, 11/09 corresponds to November 9th, whereas the actual date (September 11th) corresponds to 09/11 in MM/DD or 11/09 in DD/MM. By misinterpreting the Swedish date format (DD/MM) as US format (MM/DD) and explicitly stating it was "November 9, 1962", the Planner introduced a factual error regarding the birth date, contradicting the correct answer of September 11, 1962.
